purpose: Root container that wires a trigger to a popover-backed menu and coordinates open state, keyboard navigation, and CSS Anchor Positioning for descendant menu parts.
useWhen: Composing a menu of actions or links revealed by clicking a button trigger.
Building a custom dropdown layout from dropdown-trigger, dropdown-menu, dropdown-item, dropdown-label, and dropdown-separator parts.

avoidWhen.reason: Selecting a value from a list of options — use select or combobox instead.
Showing supplementary content rather than a menu of choices — use popover.
